abilities.description: Declared on an attack: that attack's Accuracy check gets +4, but it deals 8 less damage.

abilities.name: Regeneration = 10 points
abilities.summary: Recovers 10 HP at the end of each round.
abilities.description: At the end of every round the Living Tree regains 10 HP. This does not work while at 0 HP or less.

description: A huge walking tree, some 5m tall and often over a thousand years old; not clever but gentle and honest, it protects its forest and befriends those who respect it.

name: Belladonna

abilities.name: Psychic Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to psychic effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any psychic-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Persistent Poison
abilities.summary: Its melee hits poison: 2d poison magic damage now and every hour until cured.
abilities.description: A character hit by any of its melee attacks is poisoned unless it resists with Fortitude: it takes 2d poison magic damage at once and again every hour with no further checks, until the poison is removed. The poison does not stack. One Belladonna Leaf from its loot cures one person without any contest.

abilities.name: Snaring Vines
abilities.summary: Ensnares a character in its skirmish: no movement and -4 Evasion until freed.
abilities.description: Lashes vines around a target in the same skirmish. On a failed resistance the target is ensnared: it cannot move and suffers -4 to Evasion checks. Escaping is a de-bonding attempt (CR III p.327): a Major Action rolling 2d + adventurer level + Strength modifier against the success value of the check that caught the victim. It has so many vines that holding victims never stops it from making melee attacks or new [Snaring Vines] attempts.

description: A plant whose vines twine into a green-skinned human shape, letting it stalk and ambush prey; its touch carries a deadly lingering poison that its own leaves can cure.

name: Abyss Tree

abilities.name: Spiritualism Magic
abilities.summary: Casts Spiritualism Magic spells up to level 12; Magic Power 14.
abilities.description: Can cast Spiritualism Magic spells of level 12 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 14 (fixed 21).

abilities.name: Magic Aptitude
abilities.summary: Knows [Hawk Eye], [Magic Control], [Magic Convergence], [Multi-Action], [Rune Master], [Targeting], [Universal Metamagic], [Wordbreak].
abilities.description: Combat feats available to it: [Hawk Eye], [Magic Control], [Magic Convergence], [Multi-Action], [Rune Master], [Targeting], [Universal Metamagic], [Wordbreak].

abilities.name: Abyss Connection
abilities.summary: Inside a Shallow Abyss, can pass damage to the Trunk on to other monsters of that Abyss.
abilities.description: While in a Shallow Abyss it can share HP with any number of monsters in the same Shallow Abyss, regardless of distance or line of sight: as long as such a monster exists there, damage that would be applied to the Trunk section may instead be taken by that monster as fixed damage. The partners' HP cannot be used to heal damage the Trunk has already suffered.

abilities.name: Regeneration = 9 points
abilities.summary: Recovers 9 HP at the end of each round.
abilities.description: At the end of every round the Abyss Tree regains 9 HP. This does not work while at 0 HP or less.

abilities.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • +4
abilities.summary: The Trunk gets +4 Evasion against melee and ranged attacks while every Branch is up.
abilities.description: Its great branches shield the Trunk: that section gets +4 to Evasion checks against both melee and ranged attacks. This ends once any Branch falls to 0 HP or less.

modifiers.condition: Trunk section only, vs melee and ranged attacks, while every Branch is up

abilities.name: Toxic Branch
abilities.summary: Touch attack: 2d+15 magic damage and the target randomly loses a herb, potion or medicine.
abilities.description: A Branch brushes 1 Character within Range: Touch with its abyssal leaves: 2d+15 magic damage, and if the victim carries any herbs, potions or medicines, one of them (chosen at random) is lost. Curse-type effect; Willpower negates. Once one Branch uses it in a turn, the other Branch cannot.

description: An ordinary-looking tree inside a Shallow Abyss that thinks, casts spells and works to preserve its Abyss, sharing its wounds with the Abyss's guardians; it must be found and felled to clear the Abyss.

name: Green Torch

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.summary: Poses as an abandoned settlement or ruins; unaware characters must pass Danger Sense vs 25 or be surprised.
abilities.description: It can pose as an abandoned settlement or ruins. While it does, no Monster Knowledge check can be made against it, and a character who approaches without suspecting it must succeed on a Danger Sense check against a target number of 25 or be surprised (CR I p.144). The disguise ends automatically once it starts to act. [Sense Magic] reveals it. (The book prints only the fixed target number 25; the stored check value is the equivalent standard value 18.)

abilities.name: Psychic Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to psychic effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any psychic-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Under the Petals
abilities.summary: Attackers roll 1d each turn; while it is not above the number of living Petals, the Roots can't be targeted.
abilities.description: A character who wants to attack or affect it rolls 1d at the start of its turn. If the result is equal to or lower than the number of Petal sections still alive, the Roots section cannot be targeted that turn, not even by area effects. Magic and effects with Range: 2 (Infinite) that need no line of sight are exempt.

abilities.name: Nutrient Replenishment
abilities.summary: Heals living Petals by 60 HP in total, split in 10-point portions.
abilities.description: Restores a total of 60 HP to Petal sections that still have at least 1 HP, divided among them in portions of 10.

abilities.name: Nutrient Augmentation
abilities.summary: This turn the Stamen may use [Light Wave] twice.
abilities.description: During the turn it is used, the Stamen section can use [Light Wave] two times.

abilities.name: Light Wave
abilities.summary: Light blast at 1 character up to 30m away: 2d+16 energy magic damage.
abilities.description: Shoots light at 1 Character within Range/Area 2(30m)/Shot for 2d+16 energy magic damage (Evasion negates).

abilities.name: Undulating Petals
abilities.summary: Petal heaves: characters standing on it in a 6m radius (20 targets) fall prone and take 2d+25 physical damage.
abilities.description: The whole Petal writhes and throws off whoever stands on it (Range: Caster, Target: 1 area (6m Radius)/20): targets are knocked prone and take 2d+25 physical damage (Fortitude negates). Flying, floating or otherwise airborne characters are unaffected. Only one Petal per turn can use it.

abilities.name: Confusing Scene
abilities.summary: Characters within 30m roll 1d; on 1-2 they lose their Major Action for 1 round (five-senses only).
abilities.description: The Petal's tentacles bewilder everyone in All Areas (30m Radius)/All around it (Range: Caster). Each affected character rolls 1d, and on a 1-2 it cannot take a Major Action on its turn for 10 seconds (1 round). Only characters with five-senses perception are affected. Only one Petal per turn can use it.

description: A giant flower some 30m across whose six tentacle-covered petals imitate a village or ruins, lit by a glowing green stamen; the hidden Roots must be destroyed to kill it.

name: Yggdrasil Sapling

abilities.name: Water/Ice Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to water/ice effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any water/ice-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Earth Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to earth effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any earth-type effect or damage.

abilities.description: The Trunk section takes three Major Actions every round.

abilities.description: Can cast Fairy Magic spells of level 15 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 27 (fixed 34). Available fairy types: earth, water/ice, light, dark.

abilities.name: Breath of the World Tree
abilities.summary: The Trunk recovers 20 HP and 20 MP at the end of each round.
abilities.description: Drawing on the vitality of nature, the Trunk regains 20 HP and 20 MP at the end of every round. Lost once the Trunk is at 0 HP or less.

abilities.name: Long Branches
abilities.summary: Branch attacks reach 20m.
abilities.description: Branch attacks can be made at Range/Area 2(20m)/Target.

abilities.name: Branch Cover
abilities.summary: A Branch automatically takes single-target attacks aimed at the Trunk (once per Branch per round).
abilities.description: When the Trunk is targeted by a melee or ranged attack, or by an Area: Shot spell aimed at 1 Character, a Branch swings in and takes the damage instead, with no Evasion, Fortitude or Willpower check and without reducing it by Defense or other means. Each Branch can do this once per round; it happens automatically and the GM picks the Branch. It does not help against Area: Target spells or area effects.

abilities.name: Branch Dance
abilities.summary: All Branches together deal 2d × remaining Branches + 5 physical damage to a single foe in its skirmish.
abilities.description: The Branches thrash together at one character in the same skirmish, dealing physical damage equal to 2d multiplied by the number of remaining Branch sections, plus 5; it cannot be resisted. Only possible while no Branch has taken its Major Action yet, and afterwards every Branch's Major Action counts as used. (Formula as printed: 2d x (Remaining Branches) + 5.)

description: A young offshoot of the great World Tree Yggdrasil, grown from a far-flung seed yet still too tall to measure; its leaves and branches are said to hold Raxia's history.

name: Bloodling

weakPoint.text: HP Recovery Damage (when deals damage), +3 points

abilities.name: Vampire Bite
abilities.summary: Bites a character in its skirmish for 2d-1 physical damage and heals by the damage applied.
abilities.description: Bites one enemy in the skirmish it is in for 2d-1 physical damage (Evasion negates), then regains HP equal to the damage actually applied.

abilities.name: Vampire Body
abilities.summary: In sunlight: 3 unpreventable magic damage whenever its turn ends, and -2 Accuracy/Evasion.
abilities.description: Sunlight burns it: each time its turn ends in sunlight it suffers 3 magic damage that nothing can reduce, and while in sunlight it has -2 on all Accuracy and Evasion checks.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.summary: +1 Accuracy and Evasion in melee.
abilities.description: A Bloodling gets +1 to Accuracy checks for melee attacks and +1 to Evasion checks against melee attacks.

description: A failed, inferior Blood Sucker spawned now and then among a Nosferatu's brood: a human shape with bat-wing arms that shrieks through the night hunting the weakest prey.

name: Flying Hands

weakPoint.text: HP Recovery Damage (when deals damage), +3 points

abilities.description: Unaffected by any psychic-type effect or damage.

abilities.description: Declared on a melee attack: the Accuracy check takes -2 and the attack deals 2 extra damage if it hits. If the target evades it, the target suffers -1 to Evasion checks for 10 seconds (1 round); this stacks to a maximum of -4 and vanishes as soon as the target fails an Evasion check. Same as the combat feat [Decoy Attack I].

description: A pair of undead forearms, elbow to fingertips, that fly about in search of enemies, said to carry the regret of a warrior who died without proving their strength.

name: Adapsia

abilities.description: Takes no damage from ordinary weapons; only silvered or magic weapons can harm it.

abilities.name: Fire Vulnerability
abilities.summary: Takes 3 extra damage from fire-type damage.
abilities.description: Whenever fire-type damage hits it, that damage is increased by 3.

description: A dead person whose soul stayed in its preserved corpse and who can pass for the living; some curse the world, while others keep their reason and live quietly apart, even forming pseudo-families.

name: Lanternhead

weakPoint.text: HP Recovery Damage (when deals damage), +3 points

abilities.description: Can cast Divine Magic spells of level 6 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 8 (fixed 15). (Its lore links this magic to the Immortal Queen Zeides.)

abilities.name: Fear Curse
abilities.summary: Whisper at 1 character within 10m: 1d magic damage to MP; costs 3 MP.
abilities.description: Whispers a curse of terror into the ear of 1 Character within Range/Area 1(10m)/Target, inflicting 1d magic damage to the target's MP (Willpower halves). Costs 3 MP per use, and once a target succeeds on its Willpower check it cannot be used again that turn.

abilities.name: Nimble
abilities.summary: +2 Evasion against ranged attacks.
abilities.description: Its Evasion checks against ranged attacks get +2.

description: A lone undead humanoid head glowing blue that drifts through the air attacking all life; some can call on the Divine Magic of the Immortal Queen Zeides.

name: Warring Ash

abilities.description: Against blunt weapons its Defense counts as 5 higher, and Grappler Throws neither damage nor affect it at all. No damage can score a critical hit on it unless it comes from a recovery-type effect.

abilities.name: Shadow Sneak
abilities.summary: Ignores movement blocking and leaves skirmishes freely.
abilities.description: Movement blocking (CR II p.59) never applies to it, and it faces no restrictions when leaving a skirmish.

abilities.name: Cover with Ash
abilities.summary: Smothers an adjacent character: 2d+7 poison magic damage and no speaking for 1 round.
abilities.description: Wraps its ashes around 1 Character within Range: Touch to choke it: 2d+7 poison magic damage, and the victim cannot vocalize for 10 seconds (1 round). A successful Fortitude check halves the damage and prevents the silence.

abilities.name: Gale of Ashes
abilities.summary: Whirlwind charge along a 20m breakthrough: 2d+5 wind magic damage; not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: Tears through the air as a whirlwind along Range/Area 1(20m)/Breakthrough, dealing 2d+5 wind magic damage to everything in its path (Evasion negates). Cannot be used on consecutive turns.

description: The swirling, grudge-filled ashes of someone burned to death or carelessly cremated in the open, whirling about to attack the living.

name: Corpse Mass

abilities.description: Takes no damage from ordinary weapons; only silvered or magic weapons can harm it.

abilities.name: HP Sharing
abilities.summary: Half the HP damage to the Colored Light (rounded up) is passed to a Corpse as fixed damage.
abilities.description: Whenever the Colored Light section takes HP damage, it shifts half (rounded up) of the applied damage as fixed damage onto any Corpse section and keeps only the remainder. The damage cannot go to a Corpse already at 0 HP or less, but it may push a Corpse to 0 or below.

abilities.name: Raise Dead
abilities.summary: Revives one fallen Corpse section at full HP; costs 20 MP.
abilities.description: Brings back one Corpse section at 0 HP or less with its maximum HP. Costs the Colored Light section 20 MP.

abilities.name: Coordinated Attack
abilities.summary: Each evaded Corpse attack gives the other Corpses +1 Accuracy against that target (stacking).
abilities.description: Whenever a Corpse section's attack is evaded, the other Corpse sections get +1 on Accuracy checks against that same target, cumulatively. The bonus is lost as soon as any Corpse hits or the monster's turn ends.

modifiers.condition: per evaded Corpse attack on the same target this turn

description: The fused souls of unredeemed fallen warriors: three or more armed corpses bound together by an eerie colored light, hating the living and serving only those who let them kill.

name: Banshee

abilities.name: 2 Actions
abilities.summary: Two Major Actions per round.
abilities.description: The Banshee takes two Major Actions every round.

abilities.name: Truespeech Magic
abilities.summary: Casts Truespeech Magic spells up to level 7; Magic Power 10.
abilities.description: Can cast Truespeech Magic spells of level 7 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 10 (fixed 17). (Printed as a single line together with Spiritualism Magic at the same level and Magic Power.)

abilities.name: Magic Aptitude
abilities.summary: Knows [Universal Metamagic].
abilities.description: Combat feats available to a Banshee: [Universal Metamagic].

abilities.name: Maddening Scream
abilities.summary: Wail over 20m: victims pick targets at random for 18 rounds; once per round.
abilities.description: A shrill wail (Range: Caster, Target: All Areas (20m Radius)/All) drives listeners mad for 3 minutes (18 rounds). A maddened character still chooses its actions, Minor Actions and combat feat declarations, but the target of each attack, spell or effect is picked at random among the valid targets just before the check. The madness also ends once the character has dealt a total of 45 applied damage to its own side; after recovering that way it is immune for 1 day (other cures give no immunity). Re-applying it refreshes the duration but keeps the damage tally. Psychic-type effect; usable once per round.

description: A woman's vengeful ghost, born of grief after a terrible betrayal, that wants others to share her fate; lovely until she wails, she then withers like a mummy and leaves only crystals behind.

name: Dullahan Lord

abilities.summary: Only silvered or magic weapons can damage it.
abilities.description: Takes no damage from ordinary weapons; only silvered or magic weapons can harm it.

abilities.name: Iron Body
abilities.summary: Immune to criticals from edged weapons.
abilities.description: The Dullahan Lord cannot suffer critical hits from edged weapons.

abilities.summary: Knows [Multi-Action], [Rune Master], [Universal Metamagic].
abilities.description: Combat feats available to a Dullahan Lord: [Multi-Action], [Rune Master], [Universal Metamagic].

abilities.name: Power Strike II
abilities.summary: Declared: +12 damage on one melee attack; Evasion -2 this turn.
abilities.description: Declared on an attack: that attack deals 12 extra damage, but the monster's Evasion checks suffer -2 for the rest of the turn. Same as the combat feat [Power Strike II].

modifiers.condition: after declaring Power Strike II this turn

abilities.name: Magitech
abilities.summary: Casts Magitech spells up to level 11; Magic Power 15.
abilities.description: Can cast Magitech spells of level 11 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 15 (fixed 22).

abilities.name: Gunfire
abilities.summary: Shoots with a built-in 2H gun (magazine 5, crit 10, range 2(30m)); damage from its bullet spells.
abilities.description: Makes a shooting attack with this weapon data (name and minimum Strength omitted): Stance 2H, Max Magazine 5, Accuracy -, Critical Value 10, Extra Damage -, Range 2(30m). Its damage comes from the Magitech bullet spell loaded, as for any gun.

abilities.name: Targeting
abilities.summary: No stray shots into a skirmish.
abilities.description: Its ranged attacks fired into a skirmish never go astray (no stray shots).

abilities.name: Sonic Blaster
abilities.summary: Blast of sound within 30m: 2d bludgeoning magic damage, no Minor Actions or active feats and -2 Accuracy/Evasion for 1 round.
abilities.description: Emits a deafening roar over All Areas (30m Radius)/All around it (Range: Caster). Everyone caught takes 2d bludgeoning magic damage and for 10 seconds (1 round) is barred from Minor Actions and from declaring active combat feats, with -2 to Accuracy and Evasion checks (Fortitude negates everything). Cannot be used on consecutive turns.

abilities.name: Downswing
abilities.summary: The Rider deals +2 damage while the Manabike is up.
abilities.description: Striking down from the saddle, the Rider section deals 2 extra damage. Lost while the Manabike is at 0 HP or less.

modifiers.condition: Rider section only, while the Manabike has more than 0 HP

abilities.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • None
abilities.summary: Melee attacks cannot target the Rider while the Manabike is up.
abilities.description: The size of the Manabike shields the Rider: that section cannot be chosen as the target of melee attacks (ranged attacks are unaffected). This ends once the Manabike is reduced to 0 HP or below.

description: An upgraded Dullahan in battered white armor, head under its arm, that has traded the chariot for an ancient Manabike and wields Truespeech, Divine and Magitech magic.

name: Cursed Artist

abilities.name: Concealed Main Section
abilities.summary: Its Main Section is secretly and randomly the Musician or the Instrument.
abilities.description: When it appears, its Main Section is chosen at random between the Musician and the Instrument and kept secret. A Monster Knowledge check during Combat Preparation that reaches the Weakness value reveals the Main Section in addition to the weak point.

abilities.summary: While under any spellsong, the Musician heals 8 HP at the end of its turn.
abilities.description: Music invigorates it: while the Musician section is affected by any spellsong, it regains 8 HP at the end of its turn.

abilities.description: Plays every basic spellsong for monsters up to 5th level (CR II p.332-333) plus [Dare] (CR III p.177), all with no effect condition and centered on itself over All Areas (50m Radius). abilities.name: Finale: Dance of the Fire Dragon
abilities.summary: Finale hitting up to 5 targets within 50m for 2d+15 fire/wind magic damage; not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: Plays the finale [Finale: Dance of the Fire Dragon] against up to 5 targets within Range 2(50m); each takes 2d+15 fire/wind magic damage (Willpower halves). No Rhythm is needed. Cannot be used on consecutive turns.

abilities.name: Magic Repeat
abilities.summary: Every spell the Musician casts is cast again by the Instrument with the same targets and result.
abilities.description: Whenever the Musician section casts a spell, the Instrument section casts the same spell in that round at the same targets with the same success value, paying the same MP from its own pool.

description: An undead Magic Civilization musician, bound to its own music, that plays on with bow and a great keyboard-like instrument; stubborn and eccentric, it destroys anyone interrupting the performance.

name: Wraith

abilities.summary: Conjurers identify it automatically but must still roll for its weak point.
abilities.description: A character with the Conjurer class automatically succeeds on the Monster Knowledge check against it, but still has to roll to learn its weak point.

abilities.description: Can cast Spiritualism Magic spells of level 13 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 18 (fixed 25).

abilities.description: Combat feats available to a Wraith: [Magic Control], [Magic Convergence], [Targeting], [Universal Metamagic], [Wordbreak].

abilities.description: Blunt weapons treat its Defense as 5 higher and Grappler Throws deal it no damage. Any magic damage it receives is automatically halved, or quartered when the spell has Resistance: Half.

abilities.description: Swinging the weapons in both hands, it makes four attacks; the target of each is picked at random among the characters it could attack in melee.

abilities.name: Continuous Attack II
abilities.summary: A melee hit grants a second attack on the target; a second hit grants a third.
abilities.description: When an Undead General hits a target in melee it may attack that target again, and if that second attack also connects it may strike that same target a third time.

abilities.description: Declared on a Weapon attack: it attacks every character in the same skirmish, rolling a separate Accuracy check at -2 for each.

abilities.name: Divine Magic
abilities.summary: Casts Divine Magic spells up to level 15; Magic Power 23.
abilities.description: Can cast Divine Magic spells of level 15 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 23 (fixed 30).

abilities.name: Magic Aptitude
abilities.summary: Knows [Critical Cast II], [Double Cast], [Magic Control], [Magic Convergence], [Multi-Action], [Rune Master], [Targeting], [Universal Metamagic].
abilities.description: Combat feats available to it: [Critical Cast II], [Double Cast], [Magic Control], [Magic Convergence], [Multi-Action], [Rune Master], [Targeting], [Universal Metamagic].

abilities.name: 3 Attacks (Free)
abilities.summary: Three attacks per round, each at the same or a different target.
abilities.description: Its swarm of ghosts makes three attacks every round, each with its own Accuracy check, and picks for each whether to go after the previous target or a new one.

abilities.name: Attack Obstacle = Impossible • +4
abilities.summary: Melee attacks cannot target the Body, which also gets +4 Evasion vs ranged attacks, while the Palanquin is up.
abilities.description: The palanquin shields the Body: that section cannot be chosen as the target of melee attacks and gets +4 to Evasion checks against ranged attacks. This ends once the Palanquin is reduced to 0 HP or below.

modifiers.condition: Body section only, vs ranged attacks, while the Palanquin is up

abilities.name: Wall of Believers
abilities.summary: The Body can't be targeted by single-character or limited-count area effects unless it wishes.
abilities.description: Unless it wants to be, the Body cannot be chosen by effects whose target is '1 Character', '1 Character X' or 'X area (YY radius)/Z'; effects aimed at '1 Entire Character' or 'X area (YY radius)/All' can still include it. Lost once the Palanquin is at 0 HP or less.

abilities.name: Praise the Hierophant
abilities.summary: Palanquin pays 10 HP and MP; the Body heals 10 HP and MP and gets +2 to action checks for 1 round.
abilities.description: The dead in the palanquin offer twisted prayers: the Palanquin section loses 10 HP and 10 MP, and the Body section immediately recovers 10 HP and 10 MP and gets +2 on its action checks during the next 10 seconds (1 round).

modifiers.condition: Body section, for 1 round after Praise the Hierophant

loot.item: Holy Symbol of the Evil God

description: A high priest of evil gods who dragged its flock into undeath and is still carried and worshipped by their spirits, whose palanquin gives it its real power.

name: Dragon Zombie

weakPoint.text: HP Recovery Damage (when deals damage), +4 points

abilities.name: Miasma Vortex
abilities.summary: +4 Evasion against ranged attacks.
abilities.description: A swirling veil of miasma gives every section +4 to Evasion checks against ranged attacks.

abilities.name: Regeneration = 10 points
abilities.summary: Each section recovers 10 HP at the end of each round.
abilities.description: At the end of every round each section regains 10 HP; a section at 0 HP or less regains nothing.

abilities.name: Poison Breath
abilities.summary: Putrid gas up to 20m away: 2d+25 poison magic damage in a 6m radius (20 targets); not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: Breathes rotten gas at Range/Area 2(20m)/Shot over Target: 1 area (6m Radius)/20, dealing 2d+25 poison magic damage (Fortitude halves). Cannot be used on consecutive turns.

abilities.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
abilities.summary: Two Claw attacks per round, on the same or different targets.
abilities.description: A Dragon Zombie attacks twice per round with its Claw, rolling a separate Accuracy check for each; the second attack may go to the same target or to a different one.

abilities.name: Miasma Claws
abilities.summary: A Claw hit permanently lowers Strength by 6 (fixed-value targets: damage -1); disease.
abilities.description: A character hit by a Claw is weakened unless it resists with Fortitude: its Strength drops by 6, permanently and cumulatively, and a character whose Strength reaches 0 or less dies without a Death Check. A fixed-value character instead deals 1 less damage per application and dies after (its Monster Level / 5, rounded up, + 2) applications. Disease-type effect.

abilities.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
abilities.summary: The Head gets +4 Evasion against melee attacks while the Body is up.
abilities.description: Its huge body shields the Head: that section gets +4 to Evasion checks against melee attacks (no bonus against ranged attacks). This ends once the Body is reduced to 0 HP or below.

modifiers.condition: Head section only, vs melee attacks, while the Body is up

abilities.name: All-Out Attack
abilities.summary: Declared: +8 damage on one attack; the Wing's Evasion -3 this turn.
abilities.description: Declared on an attack: that attack deals 8 extra damage, but the Wing section using it suffers -3 on Evasion checks for the rest of the turn.

modifiers.condition: this Wing, after declaring All-Out Attack this turn

abilities.name: Tail Sweep
abilities.summary: Declared: one Tail attack against up to 5 targets in its skirmish; not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: Declared on a Tail attack: the sweep can hit as many as 5 targets in its skirmish. Not usable on consecutive turns.

description: A long-dead dragon risen again, usually witless from its rotted brain and breathing poisonous miasma instead of fire, driven by some unfinished business such as revenge or its plundered hoard.

name: Deck Chest Trap

abilities.name: Mimicry
abilities.summary: Poses as a treasure chest, a piece of furniture or a door; unaware characters must pass Danger Sense vs 15 or be surprised.
abilities.description: It can pose as a treasure chest, a piece of furniture or a door. While it does, no Monster Knowledge check can be made against it, and a character who approaches without suspecting it must succeed on a Danger Sense check against a target number of 15 or be surprised (CR I p.144). The disguise ends automatically once it starts to act. [Sense Magic] reveals it. (The book prints only the fixed target number 15; the stored check value is the equivalent standard value 8.)

abilities.name: Twin Strike & Double Attack
abilities.summary: Two Smash attacks per round, on the same or different targets.
abilities.description: A Deck Chest Trap attacks twice per round with its Smash, rolling a separate Accuracy check for each; the second attack may go to the same target or to a different one.

abilities.name: Capture
abilities.summary: If both Smash attacks hit, the target is caught and its later attacks hit automatically.
abilities.description: When both Smash attacks of [Twin Strike & Double Attack] hit the same character, it is caught: it cannot move, and from the following round on every attack this monster makes against it hits automatically. Escaping is a de-bonding attempt (CR III p.327): a Major Action rolling 2d + adventurer level + Strength modifier against the success value of the hit that caught the victim.

description: A construct that disguises itself as a chest, bookcase, door, bed or other furniture and pushes out strong arms and two stubby legs when prey comes near.

name: Plasma Sphere

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.summary: Its melee damage counts as lightning magic damage.
abilities.description: The damage of its melee attacks is treated as lightning-type magic damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Connection
abilities.summary: Touch: 5 lightning fixed damage; a Construct or Magitech target also gets +2 Accuracy and +3 lightning damage for 1 round.
abilities.description: Discharges into 1 Character within Range: Touch for 5 lightning-type fixed damage, which cannot be resisted. A Construct or Magitech target additionally gets +2 on Accuracy checks for 10 seconds (1 round), during which the physical damage it deals turns lightning-type and rises by 3.

modifiers.condition: Construct or Magitech target only (damage becomes lightning-type)

description: A floating crystal ball about 30cm across with lightning swirling inside; built in the Magic Civilization period, its discharges can also energize constructs and magitech.

name: Ghast Bishop
description: A Ghast that has grown far more powerful than its kin and often leads whole armies of Ghasts.

name: Malicious Dresser

abilities.name: Invitation to the Reversed World
abilities.summary: Draws an adjacent character into the mirror: no actions; failed escapes deal 2d+5 curse magic damage.
abilities.description: Pulls 1 Character within Range: Touch into the mirror. The captive can neither move nor take Major or Minor Actions. At the start of its turn it may try to break free with a Willpower check (as the active side) against this ability's success value: if it scores higher it is released and continues its turn, otherwise it takes 2d+5 curse magic damage. The capture ends when the capturing Mirror drops to 0 HP or the captive dies, and a Mirror already holding someone cannot use it again. Normally a multi-section character cannot be targeted, but several free Mirrors can each take in one of its sections (one check each, damage per section).

abilities.name: Mirroring
abilities.summary: Creates a GM-controlled shadow of a captive that uses the captive's abilities for one turn.
abilities.description: Usable only while [Invitation to the Reversed World] holds a captive: the Mirror conjures a shadow of the captive that the GM controls, with all of the captive's abilities and values. Items the shadow uses are consumed from the captive (though it never wastes them), and any damage or costs the shadow would suffer are taken from the controlling Mirror's HP and MP. The shadow vanishes when that Mirror's turn ends. Only one Mirror per turn may do this, and for a multi-section captive only one section can be copied.

abilities.name: Oak Wood Body
abilities.summary: Immune to criticals from edged weapons.
abilities.description: It cannot suffer critical hits from edged weapons.

abilities.name: Attack Obstacle = +4 • None
abilities.summary: Every Mirror gets +4 Evasion against melee attacks while the Foundation is up.
abilities.description: Its sturdy base shields the mirrors: all Mirror sections get +4 to Evasion checks against melee attacks (no bonus against ranged attacks). This ends once the Foundation is reduced to 0 HP or below.

modifiers.condition: Mirror sections only, vs melee attacks, while the Foundation is up

description: A runaway magical dressing stand of Magic Civilization nobles with three full-length mirrors that swallows whoever it reflects and puppets their shadow, babbling garbled Arcana guidance.

name: Phosphor Sphere

abilities.name: Fire Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to fire effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any fire-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Immunity
abilities.summary: Immune to lightning effects and damage.
abilities.description: Unaffected by any lightning-type effect or damage.

abilities.name: Energy Absorption
abilities.summary: Immune to energy damage; energy attacks heal it by the damage they would apply.
abilities.description: Energy-type damage does not harm it; instead it regains HP equal to the applied damage of any energy-type attack that hits it. Energy-type effects have no other effect on it.

abilities.name: Poison
abilities.summary: A Slam hit deals 2d poison magic damage (Fortitude negates).
abilities.description: When its Slam hits, the target also takes 2d poison magic damage unless it succeeds on a Fortitude check.

abilities.name: Poison Body
abilities.summary: Characters who hit it in melee suffer 2d poison magic damage once their turn ends.
abilities.description: A character whose melee attack hits it takes 2d poison magic damage when its own turn ends, unless it resists with Fortitude.

description: A glowing sphere about 1m across that wizards used to light and guard their exhibits; it still watches over ruins and is said to obey Arcana commands.

name: Alchemy Tooth

abilities.name: Golden Disease
abilities.summary: Bite hit infects: 2d disease magic damage, then 1d every round; victims who die turn to gold.
abilities.description: A character bitten must resist with Fortitude or contract the Golden Disease: it takes 2d disease magic damage at once and a further 1d disease magic damage whenever a round ends, with no further checks, while golden blotches creep outward from the bite. Someone killed by it becomes a stiff golden body after 24 hours and can no longer be resurrected. The Golden Serum from its loot cures the disease (not the lost HP) and, drunk beforehand, prevents infection for up to 24 hours; drinking it takes a Major Action.

abilities.name: Continuous Attack
abilities.summary: Hitting in melee grants a second attack on the same target.
abilities.description: When an Alchemy Tooth hits a target with a melee attack, it may immediately attack that same target once more.

description: A crawling construct whose bite spreads the Golden Disease, which kills and gilds its victims; crooked merchants sell the bodies as golden statues.

name: Exceed Disaster

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.summary: +1 Accuracy and Evasion in melee.
abilities.description: Every section gets +1 to Accuracy checks for melee attacks and +1 to Evasion checks against melee attacks.

abilities.name: Mithril Body
abilities.summary: Edged weapons and magic damage cannot score critical hits on it; its Sword attacks count as silver.
abilities.description: Critical hits from edged weapons and from any magic damage do not happen against it (damage is still dealt normally). Melee attacks made with the Sword section are treated as attacks with a silvered weapon.

abilities.name: Power Strike II
abilities.summary: Declared: +12 damage on one melee attack; Evasion -2 this turn.
abilities.description: Declared on an attack: that attack deals 12 extra damage, but the monster's Evasion checks suffer -2 for the rest of the turn. Same as the combat feat [Power Strike II].

modifiers.condition: after declaring Power Strike II this turn

abilities.name: Lethal Strike II
abilities.summary: Declared: +1 to the 2d of the damage roll; Evasion -1.
abilities.description: Declared on an attack: the 2d rolled for its damage count 1 higher. As a risk it takes -1 on Evasion checks for the rest of the turn. Same as the combat feat [Lethal Strike II].

modifiers.condition: after declaring Lethal Strike II this turn

abilities.name: Cleave II
abilities.summary: Declared: one weapon attack against up to 5 characters in its skirmish.
abilities.description: Declared on a weapon attack: the attack can be aimed at up to 5 characters in the skirmish it is in, with no damage penalty. Same as the combat feat [Cleave II]. One Accuracy roll covers all targets and damage is rolled per target; if [Lethal Strike II] or [Power Strike II] is also declared, the altered damage applies to one target only.

abilities.name: Painful Strike
abilities.summary: +8 damage when the damage roll's 2d shows 10+.
abilities.description: Whenever the 2d rolled for its damage total 10 or more, the attack deals 8 extra damage. With [Lethal Strike II] declared it triggers on a modified result of 10 (a natural 9).

modifiers.condition: when the 2d of the damage roll show 10 or more

abilities.name: Careful Balance
abilities.summary: Gives the Sword section [Multiple Declarations = 2 times] while the Handle is up.
abilities.description: The finely balanced handle guides the blade: the Sword section gains [Multiple Declarations = 2 times] (two different Declared-type skills per round). Lost once the Handle is at 0 HP or less.

abilities.name: Gale Breath
abilities.summary: Gust at a point up to 20m away: 2d+11 wind magic damage in a 3m radius (5 targets); not on consecutive turns.
abilities.description: The dragon carved on the handle blasts a torrent of wind at Range/Area 2(20m)/Shot over Target: 1 area (3m Radius)/5, dealing 2d+11 wind magic damage (Fortitude halves). Cannot be used on consecutive turns. (The translation misprints the formula as "2d+l1".)

abilities.name: Truespeech Magic
abilities.summary: Casts Truespeech Magic spells up to level 10; Magic Power 12.
abilities.description: Can cast Truespeech Magic spells of level 10 or lower. Magic Power and Spellcasting checks use 12 (fixed 19).

abilities.name: Magic Aptitude
abilities.summary: Knows [Magic Control], [Magic Convergence], [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Universal Metamagic].
abilities.description: Combat feats available to it: [Magic Control], [Magic Convergence], [Multi-Action], [Targeting], [Universal Metamagic].

description: A flying, self-willed 5m sword built by a Magic Civilization sorcerer studying the Swords of Genesis; strictly a sword-shaped construct, with a dragon-headed handle and a spellcasting sheath.
